title: Everyday Phrases — Charging an Electric Car
scene_zh: 給電動車充電 · 情境對話
title_quote: Our car needs a charge today.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🔌 實用給電動車充電必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Charging an Electric Car
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用的電動車充電情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從用App找充電站、插槍掃碼、咖啡休息與費用，到拔槍回家與家充續航心得，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Charging an Electric Car phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). From finding a station in the app and plugging in, to coffee breaks, fees, home charging and range tips. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our car needs a charge today.
dialogue.zh: 我們的車今天得充電了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It shows only twenty percent left.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's find a station on the app.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts faɪnd ə ˈsteɪʃən ɑn ði æp/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll open it on my phone now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ˈoʊpən ɪt ɑn maɪ foʊn naʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it show nearby charging spots?
dialogue.zh: 它有顯示附近的充電點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, three stations are close by.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which one is the nearest?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The mall station, just one mile.
dialogue.zh: 商場那個站，只差一英里。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it a fast charger there?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it has six DC fast plugs.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt hæz sɪks ˌdiːˈsi fæst plʌɡz/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, we can eat lunch there.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我們可以在那吃午飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's tap it to start navigation.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the station open right now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says open twenty-four hours.
dialogue.zh: 上面寫二十四小時營業。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I don't want a closed gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪ doʊnt wɑnt ə kloʊzd ɡeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好，我可不想吃到閉門羹。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Neither do I after this long drive.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnaɪ-ðər du aɪ ˈæftər ðɪs lɔŋ draɪv/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is the drive there?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About ten minutes in this traffic.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are any chargers busy now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two are free, four are in use.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ɑr fri fɔr ɑr ɪn juz/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That should still be fine today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's go before someone takes them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Buckle up and I'll start the car.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʊkəl ʌp ænd aɪl stɑrt ðə kɑr/
dialogue.zh: 繫好安全帶，我來發動車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I set the station as our stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɛt ðə ˈsteɪʃən æz ˈaʊər stɑp/
dialogue.zh: 我把那站設成目的地了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn left at the big lights?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, keep going past that gas sign.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ kip ˈɡoʊ-ɪŋ pæst ðæt ɡæs saɪn/
dialogue.zh: 不，過了那個加油站牌子繼續開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My battery worry is gone now.
dialogue.zh: 我的電量焦慮現在沒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Range anxiety is real though, right?
dialogue.zh: 不過續航焦慮是真的，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We made it! Look, green sign.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's the charging logo on top.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pull in slowly near number five.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This spot looks wide enough for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs spɑt lʊks waɪd ɪˈnʌf fər ʌs/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the screen on that post working?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə skrin ɑn ðæt poʊst ˈwɜr-kɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 那根樁的屏幕是好的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It lit up when I walked near.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt lɪt ʌp wɛn aɪ wɔkt nɪr/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, no waiting in line either.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We got lucky with this visit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you put the car in park?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju pʊt ðə kɑr ɪn pɑrk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and I shut it off already.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd aɪ ʃʌt ɪt ˈɔf ɔlˈrɛd-i/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did we park on the right side?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd wi pɑrk ɑn ðə raɪt saɪd/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The port is on our right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pɔrt ɪz ɑn ˈaʊər raɪt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 充電口就在這邊的右側。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I see a small canopy for shade.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ə smɔl ˈkænəpi fər ʃeɪd/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, waiting will feel cooler now.
dialogue.zh: 真好，等的時候會更涼快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any other cars charging with us?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just one van at the far end.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst wʌn væn æt ðə fɑr ɛnd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that van using a slow plug?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt væn ˈjuz-ɪŋ ə sloʊ plʌɡ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Looks like level two, not super fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊks laɪk ˈlɛvəl tu nɑt ˈsup-ər fæst/
dialogue.zh: 像是二級樁，不是超快充。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need a membership card?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the app handles all payment.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My card is saved inside the app.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ kɑrd ɪz seɪvd ɪn-ˈsaɪd ði æp/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, so we pay without cash.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn tu soʊ wi peɪ wɪˈðaʊt kæʃ/
dialogue.zh: 我也是，不用現金就能付。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now let's get the cable out.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It feels heavier than I expected.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold it low so it drags less.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɪt loʊ soʊ ɪt dræɡ lɛs/
dialogue.zh: 放低一點，就拖不到地了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll keep it off the ground.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪl kip ɪt ɔf ðə ɡraʊnd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Open the charge port for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press the button near the wheel arch.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs ðə ˈbʌtən nɪr ðə wil ɑrtʃ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, it slid open so smoothly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See the little pins inside there?
dialogue.zh: 看到裡面那些小插針了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I won't touch them, don't worry.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep your hands dry before plugging.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tip looks clean and safe.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, no dirt or water on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd noʊ dɜrt ɔr ˈwɔtər ɑn ɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Line it up with the socket now.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪn ɪt ʌp wɪð ðə ˈsɑk-ɪt naʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push it straight in, not sideways.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I heard a small click just now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hɜrd ə smɔl klɪk dʒʌst naʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That click means it locked well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A light is blinking on the handle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə laɪt ɪz ˈblɪŋkɪŋ ɑn ðə ˈhænd-əl/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blinking white means it's ready.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the screen asks me to scan.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə skrin æsks mi tu skæn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open the app and find that button.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊ-pən ði æp ænd faɪnd ðæt ˈbʌtən/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where exactly is the QR code?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's on the side under the screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ɑn ðə saɪd ˈʌn-dər ðə skrin/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My camera won't focus on it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Step back a bit and hold steady.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɛp bæk ə bɪt ænd hoʊld ˈstɛdi/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it, the app just buzzed.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now choose the station from the list.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ tʃuz ðə ˈsteɪʃən frʌm ðə lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 現在從列表裡選這個站。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It shows my car model correctly.
dialogue.zh: 它正確顯示了我的車型。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, so the power matches then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I pick fast or slow charging?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ pɪk fæst ɔr sloʊ ˈtʃɑrdʒɪŋ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We're in no rush, so level two.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪr ɪn noʊ rʌʃ soʊ ˈlɛvəl tu/
dialogue.zh: 我們不趕時間，二級就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But this plug is the fast kind.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʊt ðɪs plʌɡ ɪz ðə fæst kaɪnd/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then pick fast; lunch is short anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn pɪk fæst lʌntʃ ɪz ʃɔrt ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那就快充，反正午餐時間短。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fast costs more per minute here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, but it saves us an hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /tru bʌt ɪt seɪvz ʌs ən ˈaʊər/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's compare the total later.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app will show both prices.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I chose the fast option now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then press start session on screen.
dialogue.zh: 那就按屏幕上的開始充電。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The screen asks me to confirm.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap yes, nothing can go wrong.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's spinning: preparing to charge.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This usually takes a few seconds.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A green bar just appeared there.
dialogue.zh: 一條綠色進度條剛出現。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means current is flowing in.
dialogue.zh: 那是說電流開始進去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Always press stop before pulling out.
dialogue.zh: 拔之前一定要先按停止。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good to know, though it seems safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tu noʊ ðoʊ ɪt siːmz seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 知道了，不過看著挺安全的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See, the timer counts up from zero.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ðə ˈtaɪ-mər kaʊnts ʌp frʌm ˈzɪ-roʊ/
dialogue.zh: 看，計時器正從零往上數。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soon it shows the minutes left too.
dialogue.phonetic: /suːn ɪt ʃoʊz ðə ˈmɪn-ɪts lɛft tu/
dialogue.zh: 很快也會顯示剩餘分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We're all set, let's head inside.
dialogue.zh: 全都弄好了，我們進去吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coffee first, then check the app.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mmm, this coffee smells amazing.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two hot lattes, I'll pay this time.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu hɑt ləˈteɪz aɪl peɪ ðɪs taɪm/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the coffee line is short today.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ðə ˈkɔ-f-i laɪn ɪz ʃɔrt təˈdeɪ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll find seats by the window.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's sit and watch the battery grow.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts sɪt ænd wɑtʃ ðə ˈbæt-ər-i ɡroʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the best part of waiting.
dialogue.zh: 那是等待最有意思的部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's at thirty percent already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app refreshes every minute.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much longer until ninety?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says twenty-two more minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our lunch break fits it perfectly.
dialogue.zh: 我們的午餐休息剛好對上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They even have a play corner here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ˈiː-vən hæv ə pleɪ ˈkɔr-n-ər hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 這裡還有個兒童遊戲角。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I ordered yours with extra foam.
dialogue.zh: 你那杯我叫了多加奶泡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You remembered, that's so thoughtful.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does that number on the screen say?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt dʌz ðæt ˈnʌm-bər ɑn ðə skrin seɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 屏幕上那個數字是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One-fifty amps, a steady flow.
dialogue.zh: 一百五十安培，電流很穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that the fastest it can go?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ðə ˈfæst-ɪst ɪt kæn ɡoʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 這已經是最快的速度了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For this car, yes, that's the top.
dialogue.phonetic: /fər ðɪs kɑr jɛs ðæts ðə tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 對這輛車來說就是頂格了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It will slow down near full charge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɪl sloʊ daʊn nɪr fʊl tʃɑrdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 快充滿時速度會降下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good thing we only need ninety.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you see the running cost?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four dollars and change right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cheaper than lunch for two people.
dialogue.zh: 比我們倆的午餐還便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Electric wins on days like this.
dialogue.zh: 這種日子電動車特別划算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone buzzed, maybe an alert.
dialogue.zh: 我手機震了，可能是提醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says charging, fifty percent.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Halfway there, let me take a photo.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæfˌweɪ ðɛr lɛt mi teɪk ə ˈfoʊˌtoʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A photo of a charging post?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll show the speed to my brother.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ʃoʊ ðə spiːd tu maɪ ˈbrʌ-ðər/
dialogue.zh: 我要給我哥看這個速度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He's thinking of buying one too?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, he wants to go electric.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then this picture will help him.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There are outlets for laptops here.
dialogue.zh: 這裡有給筆記本電腦的插座。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I could answer a few work emails.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kʊd ˈæn-sər ə fju wɜrk ˈimelz/
dialogue.zh: 我正好回幾封工作郵件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free wifi too, look at the sign.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri ˈwaɪ-faɪ tu lʊk æt ðə saɪn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, I'll watch my saved video.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我來看存好的視頻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The battery climbs, the coffee shrinks.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both moving the right way now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's sixty now, feel the progress.
dialogue.zh: 到六成了，感受到進步了吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I check the app every two minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ tʃɛk ði æp ˈɛvri tu ˈmɪn-ɪts/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's what they call charge anxiety.
dialogue.zh: 這就是大家說的充電焦慮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Guilty, but look, seventy already.
dialogue.zh: 我認了，不過看，都七成了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our cafe bill just came over to us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊ-ər kəˈfeɪ bɪl dʒʌst keɪm ˈoʊvər tu ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 咖啡店的賬單剛送到我們桌上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll add it to my card payment.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl æd ɪt tu maɪ kɑrd ˈpeɪ-mənt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does the charging total say?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight dollars for forty minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That bought nearly eighty miles.
dialogue.zh: 那差不多換來八十英里續航。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair price for a quick top-up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some stations charge by the minute.
dialogue.zh: 有些站是按分鐘收費的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This one bills by energy used.
dialogue.zh: 這家是按實際用電量計費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both will show up on the receipt.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ wɪl ʃoʊ ʌp ɑn ðə rɪˈsit/
dialogue.zh: 兩項都會清清楚楚列在收據上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I like getting the email version.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want a muffin to go?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju wɑnt ə ˈmʌf-ɪn tu ɡoʊ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, two — blueberry is the baby's favorite.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tuː ˈbluː-bɛr-i ɪz ðə ˈbeɪ-biz ˈfeɪvərɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好，要兩個，藍莓是寶寶的最愛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hey, the baby's asleep in the back.
dialogue.phonetic: /heɪ ðə ˈbeɪ-biz əˈslip ɪn ðə bæk/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we move quietly when done.
dialogue.zh: 那我們走的時候輕一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stretch your arms and take a walk.
dialogue.phonetic: /strɛtʃ jʊər ɑrmz ænd teɪk ə wɔk/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One loop around the posts, then back.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn luːp əˈraʊnd ðə poʊsts ðɛn bæk/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That van left, now three spots free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt væn lɛft naʊ θri spɑts fri/
dialogue.zh: 那輛廂型車走了，空出三個位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See, this station turns over fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone parked beside the bins again.
dialogue.zh: 又把車停在垃圾桶旁邊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cables can barely reach from there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: People should read the floor signs.
dialogue.zh: 大家應該看看地上的標誌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Charging spots are not for parking.
dialogue.zh: 充電位不是拿來停著的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I took a photo of that car.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ tʊk ə ˈfoʊˌtoʊ ʌv ðæt kɑr/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can report it right in the app.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn rɪˈpɔrt ɪt raɪt ɪn ði æp/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eighty percent now, almost there.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The speed just dropped a little.
dialogue.zh: 充電速度剛剛降了一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, that's the slow-down phase.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The last ten percent takes time.
dialogue.zh: 最後那一成總是特別慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We don't need a hundred anyway.
dialogue.zh: 反正我們也不需要充滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eighty-five will set us free soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈeɪ-ti faɪv wɪl sɛt ʌs fri suːn/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set the stop limit there, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, it will end by itself.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That chair by the window is free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt tʃɛr baɪ ðə ˈwɪn-doʊ ɪz fri/
dialogue.zh: 窗邊那張椅子空出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll grab our cups and move over.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ɡræb ˈaʊ-ər kʌps ænd muːv ˈoʊvər/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This music here is really calm.
dialogue.zh: 這裡的音樂真的很舒緩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect mood for a slow Sunday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at the panels on the roof.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk æt ðə ˈpæn-əlz ɑn ðə ruːf/
dialogue.zh: 看屋頂上那些太陽能板。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This station runs on sunshine too.
dialogue.zh: 這個充電站也靠太陽能。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That makes me feel good about it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt meɪks mi fil ɡʊd ə-ˈbaʊt ɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clean power while we drink coffee.
dialogue.zh: 喝著咖啡用著清潔的電。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By the way, the app flags hot weather.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðə weɪ ðə æp flæɡz hɑt ˈwɛð-ər/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Heat can slow the charging speed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still faster than the level-two posts.
dialogue.zh: 還是比二級充電樁快多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, and the wait stays short.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's our finish time on the screen now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛrz ˈaʊ-ər ˈfɪn-ɪʃ taɪm ɑn ðə skrin naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 屏幕上現在有我們的完成時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two more minutes, then we walk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll carry the cups to the bin.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ˈkær-i ðə kʌps tu ðə bɪn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the app once more, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It just chimed a little note.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Charge complete at eighty-five.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We had a break and a full charge.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæd ə breɪk ænd ə fʊl tʃɑrdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 咖啡喝完了，電也充好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost full, but it still counts.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here comes the receipt email at last.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr kʌmz ðə rɪˈsit ˈimel æt læst/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine dollars, coffee not included.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The app shows our range is back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æp ʃoʊz ˈaʊər reɪndʒ ɪz bæk/
dialogue.zh: App顯示我們的續航回來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enough for home and tomorrow's run.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Best parking spot we've ever had.
dialogue.zh: 這是我們停過最值的位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coffee, news, and a happy battery.
dialogue.zh: 咖啡、新聞，還有滿電的電池。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's stroll back and free the car.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts stroʊl bæk ænd fri ðə kɑr/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢走回去，把車解放出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll stop the session on my phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl stɑp ðə ˈsɛʃ-ən ɑn maɪ foʊn/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the app confirm the stop?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it says session ended.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The green light finally went off.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now the plug should unlock itself.
dialogue.zh: 現在插頭應該會自動解鎖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's still holding the handle tight.
dialogue.zh: 它還把把手鎖得緊緊的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait ten seconds, then press the button.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt tɛn ˈsɛk-əndz ðɛn prɛs ðə ˈbʌtən/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hear the soft unlock click.
dialogue.zh: 我聽到輕輕解鎖的一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull it straight out, nice and easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊl ɪt streɪt aʊt naɪs ænd ˈiː-zi/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cable came out so smoothly.
dialogue.zh: 充電線順順利利就拔出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close the port cover before you forget.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊz ðə pɔrt ˈkʌvər bɪˈfɔr ju fərˈɡɛt/
dialogue.zh: 趁沒忘先把充電口蓋好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clicked shut, all sealed again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now hang that cable on the hook.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ hæŋ ðæt ˈkeɪ-b-əl ɑn ðə hʊk/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It needs to go back in the post.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt nidz tu ɡoʊ bæk ɪn ðə poʊst/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slide it in until it seats fully.
dialogue.phonetic: /slaɪd ɪt ɪn ʌnˈtɪl ɪt sits ˈfʊl-li/
dialogue.zh: 推進去直到完全卡到位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See, the holder clicks behind it.
dialogue.zh: 看，後面的支架咔一聲卡住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, nobody trips over it now.
dialogue.zh: 好，這樣就不會絆到人了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Leaving cables down is dangerous.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app even reminds you to tidy up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æp ˈiː-vən rɪˈmaɪnd ju tu ˈtaɪ-di ʌp/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My screen shows the final charge.
dialogue.zh: 屏幕上顯示著最後費用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's processing the card payment now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A minute ago it said nine dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈmɪn-ɪt əˈɡoʊ ɪt sɛd naɪn ˈdɑlərz/
dialogue.zh: 一分鐘前顯示是九美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, a small extra fee appeared.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is this two-dollar line?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I think it's the idle fee.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Idle fee? For staying too long?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we stayed ten minutes after it ended.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wi steɪd tɛn ˈmɪnɪts ˈæftər ɪt ˈɛndɪd/
dialogue.zh: 對，我們充完又多留了十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh right, the sign warned about that.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ raɪt ðə saɪn wɔrnd ə-ˈbaʊt ðæt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lesson learned, set an earlier alarm.
dialogue.zh: 學到一課，下次早點設鬧鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two dollars is fair enough here.
dialogue.zh: 在這裡兩美元也算公道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It keeps the posts moving for everyone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kips ðə poʊsts ˈmuːv-ɪŋ fər ˈɛvriˌwʌn/
dialogue.zh: 這樣大家的樁才轉得動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The payment screen says thank you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And it asks us for a rating.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪt æsks ʌs fər ə ˈreɪ-tɪŋ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five stars, this visit was easy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll mention the fast wifi too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your review helps other drivers.
dialogue.zh: 你的評價對其他司機有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Especially about which posts work well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, let's check our range display.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One-twenty-seven miles on the dash.
dialogue.zh: 儀表上是一百二十七英里。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That covers home with room to spare.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈkʌv-ərz hoʊm wɪð rum tu spɛr/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I love that we skipped the gas line.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lʌv ðæt wi skɪpt ðə ɡæs laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 不用去加油站排隊，真爽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hey, this car here never moved.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Its cable is in, but nobody's inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈkeɪ-b-əl ɪz ɪn bʌt ˈnoʊ-bə-diz ɪn-ˈsaɪd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The screen shows it finished an hour ago.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə skrin ʃoʊz ɪt ˈfɪn-ɪʃt ən ˈaʊər əˈɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 屏幕顯示它一小時前就充完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's exactly why idle fees exist.
dialogue.zh: 佔位費的存在就是為了這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we say something about it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app has a report-a-blocker option.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æp hæz ə rɪˈpɔrt ə ˈblɑk-ər ˈɑp-ʃən/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll note the plate and the time.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl noʊt ðə pleɪt ænd ðə taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 我把車牌和時間記下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kind but firm, that's the right tone.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaɪnd bʌt fɜrm ðæts ðə raɪt toʊn/
dialogue.zh: 客氣但堅定，態度剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone left a cup on the post.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌwʌn lɛft ə kʌp ɑn ðə poʊst/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take it inside to the trash can.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ɪt ɪn-ˈsaɪd tu ðə træʃ kæn/
dialogue.zh: 拿去裡面的垃圾桶丟掉吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hope cleaners come by often.
dialogue.zh: 希望清潔人員常來打掃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A tidy spot helps everyone move fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈtaɪdi spɑt hɛlpz ˈɛvriˌwʌn moʊv fæst/
dialogue.zh: 乾淨的環境讓大家快充快走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we owe anything else here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the app says paid in full.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ði æp sɛz peɪd ɪn fʊl/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep the email just in case.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll star it in my inbox now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl stɑr ɪt ɪn maɪ ˈɪn-bɑks naʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you grab the paper receipt?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we're going paperless today.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，我們今天用電子的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The screen wished us a good trip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə skrin wɪʃt ʌs ə ɡʊd trɪp/
dialogue.zh: 屏幕上祝我們一路順風。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even chargers say goodbye now.
dialogue.zh: 現在連充電樁都會道別了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ready for the road again?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, let me put the seats back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlˌmoʊst lɛt mi pʊt ðə sits bæk/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The car wakes up so quietly.
dialogue.zh: 車子啟動時安安靜靜的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That hum will never get old.
dialogue.zh: 那嗡嗡聲怎麼聽都不膩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check your mirrors, signal, and go.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wave bye to the charging posts.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We were here just over an hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɜr hɪr dʒʌst ˈoʊvər ən ˈaʊər/
dialogue.zh: 我們才來了一個多小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And it cost eleven bucks in total.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪt kɔst ɪˈlɛvən bʌks ɪn ˈtoʊtl/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, did we leave the window open?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt dɪd wi liːv ðə ˈwɪn-doʊ ˈoʊ-pən?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app closes them, watch the mirror.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æp ˈkloʊ-z-əz ðɛm wɑtʃ ðə ˈmɪr-ər/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, it rolled up from my phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ɪt roʊld ʌp frʌm maɪ foʊn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Modern cars are full of tricks.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That station is full again already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We timed our visit perfectly then.
dialogue.zh: 那我們這次時間掐得正好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you see the price board outside?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju si ðə praɪs bɔrd ˌaʊtˈsaɪd?/
dialogue.zh: 外面那塊價格板你看到了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Peak hours cost double on weekends.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So we charge weekday mornings now.
dialogue.zh: 那我們以後改平早上充。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, quiet streets and cheaper juice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the map shows a backup station.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ðə mæp ʃoʊz ə ˈbækˌəp ˈsteɪ-ʃən/
dialogue.zh: 看，地圖上還有個備用充電站。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good to know for our long trips.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tu noʊ fər ˈaʊ-ər lɔŋ trɪps/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm already planning the next stop.
dialogue.zh: 我已經在計劃下一站了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save it to your favorite list.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saved, with a note about the coffee.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪvd wɪð ə noʊt ə-ˈbaʊt ðə ˈkɔ-f-i/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The most important detail of all.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone says low battery now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're like our car, always charging.
dialogue.zh: 你跟我們車一樣，老在充電。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plug yours into the car's port then.
dialogue.phonetic: /plʌɡ jʊərz ˈɪn-tu ðə kɑrz pɔrt ðɛn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One USB cable, problem solved.
dialogue.zh: 一條數據線，問題解決了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Green highway, fresh air, full charge.
dialogue.zh: 綠色公路，新鮮空氣，滿格電。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Driving never felt so relaxed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No engine noise, just the tires.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And my podcast finally has room.
dialogue.zh: 我的播客終於有空間了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We'll pass the exit in one mile.
dialogue.phonetic: /wil pæs ði ˈɛɡ-zɪt ɪn wʌn maɪl/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set the cruise and enjoy the glide.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ðə kruːz ænd ɛn-ˈdʒɔɪ ðə ɡlaɪd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This stop turned out really well.
dialogue.zh: 這趟休息站之行很成功。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Charging trips are little vacations now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time we bring the whole team.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst taɪm wi brɪŋ ðə hoʊl tim/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kids, coffee, cables, all in one place.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɪdz ˈkɔ-f-i ˈkeɪ-b-əlz ɔl ɪn wʌn pleɪs/
dialogue.zh: 孩子、咖啡、充電線，一次搞定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Home at last, let's plug it in.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊm æt læst lɛts plʌɡ ɪt ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 終於到家了，把車插上吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The garage charger is ready to use.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡəˈrɑʒ ˈtʃɑrdʒ-ər ɪz ˈrɛdi tu juz/
dialogue.zh: 車庫的充電樁已經備好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I love charging in my own driveway.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lʌv ˈtʃɑrdʒ-ɪŋ ɪn maɪ oʊn ˈdraɪvˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我愛死在自己車道充電了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No app, no lines, no waiting at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ æp noʊ laɪnz noʊ ˈweɪt-ɪŋ ət ɔl/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just back it in and close the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst bæk ɪt ɪn ænd kloʊz ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 倒進去然後關上車庫門就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The wall box has its own short cable.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wɔl bɑks hæz ɪts oʊn ʃɔrt ˈkeɪ-b-əl/
dialogue.zh: 壁掛盒帶著自己的短線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Level two beats the basic wall plug.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛvəl tu bits ðə ˈbeɪsɪk wɔl plʌɡ/
dialogue.zh: 二級充電樁比普通牆插快得多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It fills the car overnight easily.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you schedule the night rates?
dialogue.zh: 你設好夜間費率的時間了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it starts at eleven tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Electricity is cheapest after midnight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So the car wakes up full and cheap.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə kɑr weɪks ʌp fʊl ænd tʃip/
dialogue.zh: 車子醒來又滿電又省錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much did we spend last month?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ dɪd wi spɛnd læst mʌnθ?/
dialogue.zh: 上個月我們花了多少電費？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just thirty on the charging bill.
dialogue.zh: 充電賬單只有三十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our old car cost sixty in gas.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊ-ər oʊld kɑr kɔst ˈsɪk-sti ɪn ɡæs/
dialogue.zh: 舊車光是油費就要六十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we save thirty every month.
dialogue.zh: 所以我們每月省三十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That pays for the weekend trips.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or two nice dinners out, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 老實說也夠兩次外出晚餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The installer said keep it cool.
dialogue.zh: 安裝師傅說要保持散熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't hang things over the charger box.
dialogue.phonetic: /doʊnt hæŋ θɪŋz ˈoʊvər ðə ˈtʃɑrdʒ-ər bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 別在充電盒上面掛東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep the connector clean and dry.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A quick wipe takes ten seconds.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we charge to a hundred daily?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi tʃɑrdʒ tu ə ˈhʌndrəd ˈdeɪ-li?/
dialogue.zh: 每天都要充到百分之百嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, eighty is better for the battery.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈeɪ-ti ɪz ˈbɛt-ər fər ðə ˈbæt-ər-i/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And don't let it drop below twenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd doʊnt lɛt ɪt drɑp bɪˈloʊ ˈtwɛn-ti/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Low and hot are the battery's enemies.
dialogue.phonetic: /loʊ ænd hɑt ər ðə ˈbæt-ər-ɪz ˈɛn-ə-miz/
dialogue.zh: 過低和過熱是電池的敵人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's why I plug in when I'm home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts waɪ aɪ plʌɡ ɪn wɛn aɪm hoʊm/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little charge often beats a big one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪt-əl tʃɑrdʒ ˈɔfən bits ə bɪɡ wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 少量多次比一次猛充好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about long winter drives?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cold can cut the range by a third.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld kæn kʌt ðə reɪndʒ baɪ ə θɜrd/
dialogue.zh: 寒冷可能砍掉三分之一續航。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So we plan stops before we leave.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wi plæn stɑps bɪˈfɔr wi liːv/
dialogue.zh: 所以出門前先規劃好停靠點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app marks stations along the route.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æp mɑrks ˈsteɪ-ʃənz əˈlɔŋ ðə ruːt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Heating uses more power, did you know?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhi-t-ɪŋ ˈjuz-ɪz mɔr ˈpaʊər dɪd ju noʊ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The seat warmers are my secret trick.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sit ˈwɔr-mərz ər maɪ ˈsikrɪt trɪk/
dialogue.zh: 座椅加熱是我的祕密招數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm clothes beat a warm cabin.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I keep a blanket right in the car.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kip ə ˈblæŋkɪt raɪt ɪn ðə kɑr/
dialogue.zh: 我車裡正好放了條毯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How did the range do this week?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ dɪd ðə reɪndʒ du ðɪs wik?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close to two hundred miles in all.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊs tu tu ˈhʌndrəd maɪlz ɪn ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 這週總共差不多跑了兩百英里。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smooth driving stretches it even more.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No sudden stops and no quick launches.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈsʌd-ən stɑps ænd noʊ kwɪk ˈlɔn-tʃɪz/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Regen braking gives a little power back.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈdʒɛn ˈbreɪk-ɪŋ ɡɪvz ə ˈlɪt-əl ˈpaʊər bæk/
dialogue.zh: 動能回收會把一點電還回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Downhills feel like free charging almost.
dialogue.zh: 下坡幾乎就像在免費充電。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tires low on air waste energy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I check them every Sunday morning.
dialogue.zh: 我每個週日早上都檢查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No oil changes, that's the best part.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɔɪl ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz ðæts ðə bɛst pɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 不用換機油，這是最棒的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just wipers, tires, and one filter.
dialogue.zh: 只有雨刷、輪胎和一個濾芯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The app even tracks my driving habits.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æp ˈiː-vən træks maɪ ˈdraɪv-ɪŋ ˈhæb-ɪts/
dialogue.zh: App還會記錄我的駕駛習慣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It gave me a smooth-driver score.
dialogue.zh: 它給了我平穩駕駛評分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Score of ninety-two, not bad at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /skɔr ʌv ˈnɪn-ti tu nɑt bæd æt ɔl/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, it says I saved ten dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ɪt sɛz aɪ seɪvd tɛn ˈdɑlərz/
dialogue.zh: 你看，上面說我省了十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Monthly bills are so boringly simple.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One home charge, one fast stop, done.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn hoʊm tʃɑrdʒ wʌn fæst stɑp dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 家裡充一次，外面快充一次，搞定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My friend still doubts the whole thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ frɛnd stɪl daʊts ðə hoʊl θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我朋友還在懷疑這一切。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He asked where we charge on trips.
dialogue.phonetic: /hiː æskt wɛr wi tʃɑrdʒ ɑn trɪps/
dialogue.zh: 他問我們出門旅行怎麼充電。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I showed him today's lunchtime stop.
dialogue.zh: 我給他看今天中午這次停靠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With coffee, too — that sold him.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if the house battery stores extra sun?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt ɪf ðə haʊs ˈbætəri stɔrz ˈɛkstrə sʌn/
dialogue.zh: 家裡那塊電池能多存太陽能嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and it powers the lights at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd ɪt ˈpaʊ-ərz ðə laɪts æt naɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our whole home feels like a machine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊ-ər hoʊl hoʊm filz laɪk ə məˈʃin/
dialogue.zh: 整個家像一台聰明的機器。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A quiet machine that saves us money.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈkwaɪət məˈʃin ðæt seɪvz ʌs ˈmʌn-i/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if the power goes out someday?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf ðə ˈpaʊər ɡoʊz aʊt ˈsʌm-ˌdeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 要是哪天停電了怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The car can even power the fridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɑr kæn ˈiː-vən ˈpaʊər ðə frɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 車子甚至能給冰箱供電。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's like a huge rolling battery.
dialogue.zh: 它就像一塊會跑的大電池。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Glad ours sleeps in our garage.
dialogue.zh: 高興我們家這塊睡在車庫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's plan a road trip next month.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts plæn ə roʊd trɪp nɛkst mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 下個月我們規劃一次自駕遊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two nights away, three charging stops.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll mark the stations with good coffee.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl mɑrk ðə ˈsteɪ-ʃənz wɪð ɡʊd ˈkɔ-f-i/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the ones with clean restrooms too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ði wʌnz wɪð klin ˈrɛstˌrumz tu/
dialogue.zh: 也標上洗手間乾淨的站點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My range calculator says it's easy.
dialogue.zh: 我的續航計算說這很容易。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Battery warm, tires full, and go.
dialogue.zh: 電池預熱、胎壓足，就出發。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Remember our first charge, how nervous?
dialogue.zh: 還記得第一次充電多緊張嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We read the manual for an hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi rid ðə ˈmæn-jə-wəl fər ən ˈaʊər/
dialogue.zh: 我們光讀說明書就花了一小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it takes us five flat minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪt teɪks ʌs faɪv flæt ˈmɪn-ɪts/
dialogue.zh: 現在整套動作五分鐘搞定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Click, scan, coffee, drive — that's all.
dialogue.zh: 插槍、掃碼、咖啡、走人，就這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The kids call it the plug-in game.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɪdz kɔl ɪt ðə plʌɡ-ɪn ɡeɪm/
dialogue.zh: 孩子們管這叫插槍遊戲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Whoever finishes plugging gets the snacks.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They think electric cars are magic.
dialogue.zh: 他們覺得電動車是魔法。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: To them, sunshine really drives us.
dialogue.zh: 對他們來說，真是陽光在開車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe they're not wrong about that.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Solar midday, quiet home at night.
dialogue.zh: 中午靠太陽，晚上安靜回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our electric life fits so neatly.
dialogue.zh: 我們的電動生活過得很順。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Charge, drive, repeat, and smile.
dialogue.zh: 充電、開車、再來一次，微笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last look at the garage light.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn læst lʊk æt ðə ɡəˈrɑʒ laɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue and steady, charging all night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By breakfast we'll have a hundred.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the cheapest energy of the day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ði ˈtʃipɪst ˈɛn-ər-dʒi ʌv ðə deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 用的還是一天裡最便宜的電。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set the alarm for half past seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ði əˈlɑrm fər hæf pæst ˈsɛvən/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll leave with a full and happy tank.
dialogue.phonetic: /wil liːv wɪð ə fʊl ænd ˈhæp-i tæŋk/
dialogue.zh: 我們將帶著滿滿的電出發。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night, quiet car in the garage.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naɪt ˈkwaɪət kɑr ɪn ðə ɡəˈrɑʒ/
dialogue.zh: 晚安，安靜地待在車庫吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good night, may the battery dream.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn off the lights and rest now.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ˈɔf ðə laɪts ænd rɛst naʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow's miles are already waiting.
dialogue.zh: 明天的旅程已經在等待。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No sounds but the rain outside.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The house sleeps, the car drinks power.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə haʊs slips ðə kɑr drɪŋks ˈpaʊər/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slow and steady fills the night.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By dawn we'll be ready again.
dialogue.zh: 天亮時我們又準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Close your eyes and breathe out.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The charging hum will lull you to sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtʃɑrdʒ-ɪŋ hʌm wɪl lʌl ju tə slip/
dialogue.zh: 充電的低鳴會哄你入睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Drift off to the quiet current.
dialogue.zh: 隨著安靜的電流入睡吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Full battery, full heart, sweet dreams.
dialogue.zh: 滿電的車，滿足的心，好夢。
